beats.phrase: Two people join the same gym.
beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: two monochrome halftone cutout figures stand side by side on the cream stage in front of a flat burnt orange disc, gym doorway cutout behind them

beats.change_only: both figures raise one arm in a matching gesture

beats.scene: MEDIUM: one monochrome cutout figure walks right across the cream stage, the burnt orange disc small behind, a torn paper calendar strip along the bottom with abstract tick marks

beats.phrase: The other quit in week two.
beats.change_only: a second figure drops out of frame at the left, only their legs still visible

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a clenched monochrome halftone fist cutout with a burnt orange marker circle drawing itself around it, then a burnt orange cross stroke over the circle

beats.phrase: James Clear calls it a systems problem.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: an abstract burnt orange arrow loop cycling between three monochrome cutout icons arranged as a circuit on the cream stage

beats.phrase: A goal names only the destination.
beats.change_only: a single burnt orange flag cutout snaps down at the far right of the loop
the arrow loop fades to monochrome, leaving only the orange flag

beats.phrase: A system is what Tuesday looks like.
beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a stage plate of a plain room, one monochrome cutout figure seated at a desk, a burnt orange half disc low behind, soft paper drop shadows

beats.change_only: the seated figure slumps forward, head lowered onto one hand

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a row of five identical monochrome halftone runner cutouts in a line across the cream stage, each with an offset burnt orange stroke behind

beats.change_only: a burnt orange marker underline sweeps across all five runners at once

beats.phrase: What separates them is the first move.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: an oversized monochrome photographic hand enters from the right and places one small burnt orange block onto the cream stage

beats.change_only: the orange block shrinks to a quarter of its size
the hand slides the small orange block much nearer to the front edge

beats.phrase: Clear's rule is shrink the habit.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: a monochrome cutout of a tall stack of books on the cream stage, a burnt orange downward arrow drawn beside it

beats.change_only: the tall stack collapses to a single book

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a single monochrome open book cutout with a burnt orange marker circle drawn on one corner, tape strips at the edges
MEDIUM: two pinned photo cards on the cream stage with white borders and tape, one showing a monochrome page cutout, one showing a monochrome figure in a push up position

beats.change_only: a third pinned card taped down at the right showing a monochrome guitar cutout

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a dot-matrix halftone bar barely filled at the left of the cream stage, mostly empty, one burnt orange dot at its base

beats.change_only: a burnt orange marker cross stroke draws itself over the bar

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a monochrome halftone cutout of a foot stepping onto a torn paper step, a burnt orange stroke marking the step edge

beats.change_only: a second foot lands on the step above

beats.scene: MEDIUM: the oversized monochrome hand tilts a fan of pinned paper cards on the cream stage, one card popped in burnt orange
FULL-SPREAD: a flat stage plate of a hallway, a monochrome door cutout, a pair of burnt orange running shoes placed at its base as the single color pop

beats.change_only: a monochrome phone cutout slides out of frame to the left

beats.scene: MEDIUM: a kitchen counter stage plate, a burnt orange fruit bowl cutout in the open, a monochrome biscuit tin cutout tucked behind a cupboard door

beats.change_only: the oversized hand reaches in and lifts the orange fruit

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: an overhead flat plan of a room built from torn paper shapes, burnt orange strokes connecting the objects into a route

beats.change_only: the burnt orange route straightens into one clean line

beats.phrase: Willpower is a poor daily strategy.
beats.scene: MEDIUM: a dot-matrix semicircle gauge on the cream stage filled with burnt orange dots at the left, a monochrome cutout figure standing beside it

beats.change_only: nearly all the orange dots flip to monochrome, leaving one

beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: the same room plan plate, steady and unchanged, one large flat burnt orange disc behind it, no figure present
MEDIUM: a monochrome cutout of an oversized mountain peak on the cream stage with a burnt orange marker cross stroke drawn over its summit

beats.change_only: the mountain cutout tips over and slides down out of frame

beats.scene: CLOSE-UP: a single small torn paper step on the cream stage with a burnt orange stroke along its edge, a monochrome shoe cutout at its base

beats.change_only: three more paper steps snap into place rising to the right

beats.phrase: That is Atomic Habits, James Clear.
beats.scene: FULL-SPREAD: a single monochrome halftone book cutout standing upright at the centre of the cream stage on a large flat burnt orange disc, tape strips at the corners

beats.change_only: a burnt orange marker circle draws itself around the standing book
